quotes: I say, I say, boy — pay attention when I'm talkin' to ya!
That's a joke, son, a flag-waver. You're built too close to the ground.
Nice boy, but he's got more nerve than a bum tooth.
I keep pitchin' 'em and you keep missin' 'em.
Pay attention, boy! I'm cuttin' but you ain't bleedin'!
It's a joke, son. Don't you get it?
Boy, you're about as sharp as a bag of wet mice.
I say, I say — that boy's about as bright as Alaska in December.
This boy's making a career of ignoring me.
Nice, I say nice try, but not good enough.
Go away, son, ya bother me.
I say, I say, what in the — open your ears, boy!
You've got the IQ of a fence post, son.
Don't, I say don't bother me with trifles.
Fortunately, I keep my wits about me.
That's the last, I say the last time I play straight man to a chicken.
The boy's as quick as a hiccup, I'll give him that.
I say, look at me when I'm talkin' to ya!
Son, you make me realize talk is cheap — and so are you.
That dog is lower than a snake's belly in a wagon rut.
